gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.

gaps.sentence: She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.

gaps.sentence: She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).

gaps.sentence: The rules don't ___ visitors to touch the paintings.
gaps.explanation: allow + object + to-infinitive: allow visitors to touch. (let + bare: let visitors touch.)
would rather takes the bare infinitive: I'd rather stay.
